newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Norfolk Southern restarted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Norfolk Southern restarted.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said on Tuesday it reinstated coverage of railroad company Norfolk Southern Corp with a neutral rating intermediate-term and a buy rating long-term.
-- Merrill analyst Michael Lloyd said in a research note his 1997 earnings estimate was $6.40 per share and his 1998 estimate was $6.90 per share.

-- Lloyd said the Norfolk Southern's valuation was attractive over the two to three year time frame because the expected addition of the Conrail Inc properties should enhance Norfolk's growth prospects.
-- But more near-term, Norfolk was still not as cheap as some other North American rail stocks, Lloyd said.
